episodes.synopsis: Elymas Edvaughn is disowned by his father for becoming a Heavy Knight.
episodes.title: I'm Elymas the Heavy Knight

episodes.synopsis: Elymas uses his wits and game knowledge to defeat a much more powerful monster.
episodes.title: Menacing Foul Eight-Legged Beast

episodes.synopsis: Elymas finds himself surrounded by fearful newbies and an arrogant veteran on his first Raid Quest.
episodes.title: The Raid Quest

episodes.synopsis: With Gowtan paralyzed, Elymas must survive against the Mad Headder until he can get back in the fight.
episodes.title: Existence Evolution

episodes.synopsis: Elymas goes shopping for a skillbook only to discover they're prohibitively expensive.
episodes.title: Fang of Smoldering Insanity

episodes.synopsis: Elymas begs Ruche to join his party so he can use her skills to find the item he needs.
episodes.title: Ruche the Pierrot

episodes.synopsis: Elymas uses his game knowledge to exploit the weaknesses of the elusive Golden Raana.
episodes.title: Golden Raana Farming

episodes.synopsis: Elymas and Ruche's celebration is interrupted by a wandering dungeon boss.
episodes.title: Wandering

episodes.synopsis: Ruche returns to save Elymas from a desperate situation, and they make one last gamble to beat the Dreamlord.
episodes.title: Dreamlord

episodes.synopsis: Elymas and Ruche celebrate their payout and promotion and return to the shady shop for a Skill Book.
episodes.title: Negotiation

episodes.synopsis: Elymas' father hears about his success and visits the guild with Malice, who has a twisted attachment to him.
episodes.title: Inescapable Past

episodes.synopsis: Elymas activates the true power of the Heavy Knight to make a comeback against Malice.
episodes.title: Malice the Master Swordsman

episodes.synopsis: After defeating Malice and saying goodbye to his father, Elymas visits Lacoryna, the holy land of adventurers.
episodes.title: Lacoryna, City of Adventurers

episodes.synopsis: Elymas and Ruche take on an overpowering foe in hopes of acquiring powerful materials.
episodes.title: Mythril Giant

episodes.synopsis: With their new skills gained on level up, Elymas and Ruche decide to take on the Rock Centipede.
episodes.title: Dreamlord of the Dreamhole

episodes.synopsis: The Rock Centipede Existence Evolves into a Death Amude, trapping Elymas and Ruche in a desperate situation.
episodes.title: No Defense Spared

episodes.synopsis: Elymas is unsettled by the Dreamlord’s Existence Evolution, so he asks to meet with the guildmaster.
episodes.title: Guildmaster Hailenn

episodes.synopsis: In order to process the mythril they acquired, Elymas and Ruche visit a skilled blacksmith.
episodes.title: Blacksmith Veruga

episodes.synopsis: Elymas is challenged to a fishing contest by the leader of the Sea Dragon’s Fang angler clan.
episodes.title: Empress of the Angler Clan

episodes.synopsis: Elymas and Ruche return to pick up their sword and discover that someone else is trying to buy it.
episodes.title: Magic Swordsman Hilde

episodes.synopsis: Carlos, who is investigating the monster disasters in the area, invites Elymas and Ruche on a Raid Quest.
episodes.title: Blackened Flameblade
